artworks.title: Return of Hephaestus (Attic red-figure pelike)
artworks.description: Munich pelike: Dionysus leads the cast-out smith back to Olympus with his thiasos — the visual tradition that follows Hera's rejection of the lame newborn Hephaestus.

artworks.title: Return of Hephaestus (Laconian kylix)
artworks.description: Rhodes AM 10711: archaic Laconian cup of Hephaestus' return — the smith-god's expulsion and homecoming told as procession, not cradle scene.

popCulture.title: Hephaestus
popCulture.description: Born lame — or cast from Olympus — the smith-god's birth remains the myth of craft forged from rejection.
